company.name: Base Power
company.shortDescription: Base Power provides home battery systems, electricity services, and energy management solutions for residential customers.
company.description: Base Power provides home battery systems, retail electricity services, and energy management solutions for residential customers. The company installs battery storage systems that provide backup power during outages and help manage electricity usage. Its platform combines distributed battery storage with electricity services to support home energy management and grid operations.

productsAndServices.description: A residential battery system that provides automatic backup power during outages and can be managed to support grid stability. Systems are sized for individual homes and typically range from 20 kWh to 50 kWh.
productsAndServices.name: Base Battery

productsAndServices.description: A bundled residential electricity and battery-backup service that combines a fixed-rate Base electricity plan with an automatically activated home battery system.
productsAndServices.name: Base Backup + Energy

productsAndServices.description: A residential electricity service offering fixed-rate power without requiring Base battery hardware. It is available in select Texas service areas and includes straightforward billing and utility delivery charges.
productsAndServices.name: Base Energy

productsAndServices.description: A residential battery-backup service for customers who retain their existing electricity provider. The installed battery automatically supplies power during outages and is available only in selected utility-partnership areas.
productsAndServices.name: Base Backup Only

productsAndServices.description: A software-enabled distributed energy management service that coordinates residential batteries for grid balancing, outage readiness, and utility demand support.
productsAndServices.name: Base Grid Balancing and Energy Management

productsAndServices.description: A fixed-rate commercial electricity service for Texas businesses, designed to provide predictable electricity pricing across eligible ERCOT market areas.
productsAndServices.name: Base Energy for Business
